FGT1557.name: Network Sniffing on 5G Core
FGT1557.description: Adversaries may sniff network traffic on the 5G core to capture sensitive data. The 5GC uses N1-N14 interfaces; unencrypted or weakly encrypted control-plane traffic can be intercepted between NFs.
indicators: promiscuous mode on SBI interface
unexpected pcap or tcpdump process on NF host
high volume outbound traffic from AMF/SMF/UPF
packet capture files in unusual directories
anomalous CPU spike on NF coinciding with traffic burst
FGT1557.detection_guidance: Monitor for promiscuous-mode changes on 5GC network interfaces. Alert on execution of packet capture utilities (tcpdump, tshark) on NF hosts. Correlate outbound data volume anomalies with SBI interface activity.
FGT1557.mitigation_guidance: Enforce mutual TLS (mTLS) on all 5GC SBI interfaces (3GPP TS 33.501). Deploy NF-level process whitelisting. Segment control-plane traffic from management interfaces.

FGT1078.name: Valid Accounts - 5G NF Service Account Abuse
FGT1078.description: Adversaries abuse valid NF service accounts or OAuth2 tokens on the Service Based Interface (SBI) to authenticate to NFs without triggering standard IDS alerts.
indicators: NF service account login from unexpected source IP
OAuth2 token reuse outside expected NF-to-NF pattern
access to NRF without prior registration flow
repeated token requests for same NF within short window
service account used outside business hours
FGT1078.detection_guidance: Baseline NF-to-NF OAuth2 token exchange patterns. Alert on tokens used from unexpected source NFs or IPs. Monitor NRF registration anomalies.
FGT1078.mitigation_guidance: Rotate NF service account credentials regularly. Enforce certificate-based mutual authentication. Implement token binding to source NF identity.

FGT1190.name: Exploit Public-Facing Application - N2/N4 Interface
FGT1190.description: Adversaries exploit vulnerabilities in N2 (AMF-RAN) or N4 (SMF-UPF) interface implementations to gain initial foothold in the 5G core.
indicators: malformed NGAP messages to AMF
unexpected PFCP session establishment from unknown peer
buffer overflow pattern in N4 message parsing logs
crash-restart loop on AMF or SMF process
unknown source IP sending N2/N4 control messages
FGT1190.detection_guidance: Deploy deep-packet inspection on N2/N4 interfaces. Alert on NGAP/PFCP message anomalies, unexpected source IPs, and NF crash-restart patterns.
FGT1190.mitigation_guidance: Apply vendor patches for N2/N4 interface parsers. Enforce IP allowlisting for N2/N4 peers. Enable NGAP/PFCP message rate-limiting.

FGT1499.name: Endpoint Denial of Service - SCTP Flood on N2
FGT1499.description: Adversaries send a flood of SCTP INIT or DATA chunks to overwhelm the N2 (AMF) interface, preventing legitimate gNBs from registering UEs and causing denial of service.
indicators: SCTP INIT flood from single or rotating source IPs
AMF connection table exhaustion
gNB registration failures spiking above baseline
SCTP retransmit storm in N2 interface logs
AMF CPU above 90% with no corresponding legitimate traffic
FGT1499.detection_guidance: Monitor SCTP connection rates on N2 interface. Alert on INIT flood patterns. Track gNB registration failure rates against baseline. Correlate with source IP reputation.
FGT1499.mitigation_guidance: Enable SCTP cookie mechanism on AMF. Deploy rate-limiting for SCTP INIT messages. Implement IP reputation filtering at network perimeter.

FGT1595.name: Active Scanning - 5G Network Enumeration
FGT1595.description: Adversaries probe the 5G network to discover NF endpoints, slice configurations, and PLMN parameters by sending crafted NAS or SBI probe messages.
indicators: port scan targeting SBI port 443 across multiple NF IPs
NAS registration requests with invalid IMSI patterns
NRF query flood for NF profiles
repeated HTTP OPTIONS on SBI endpoints
systematic probing of AMF discovery endpoints
FGT1595.detection_guidance: Alert on systematic SBI endpoint probing. Monitor NRF for bulk profile query anomalies. Detect NAS registration patterns with invalid IMSI ranges.
FGT1595.mitigation_guidance: Implement rate-limiting on NRF discovery. Enforce NF authentication before profile disclosure. Deploy honeypot NF endpoints.

FGT5019.name: SS7 Location Tracking via MAP-SRI
FGT5019.description: Adversary sends a MAP Send-Routing-Information (SRI) query through the SS7 network to obtain the IMSI and serving MSC address of a target subscriber, enabling location tracking.
indicators: MAP-SRI request from unexpected GT address
bulk SRI queries targeting sequential MSISDNs
SRI response returned to non-home PLMN address
HLR/HSS query volume spike from external SS7 peer
SRI origination from known roaming partner without active roamers
FGT5019.detection_guidance: Deploy SS7 firewall with MAP-SRI rate limiting and GT validation. Alert on SRI originating from non-whitelisted GT addresses. Correlate bulk SRI with absence of legitimate roaming sessions.
FGT5019.mitigation_guidance: Deploy GSMA FS.11/FS.19 compliant SS7 firewall. Block MAP-SRI from non-authorized GTs. Implement IMSI and MSISDN rate-limiting per peer.

FGT5020.name: SS7 Network Reconnaissance via MAP-SAI
FGT5020.description: Adversary sends MAP Send-Authentication-Info (SAI) requests to enumerate authentication vectors from the HLR/HSS, useful for later SIM cloning or authentication attacks.
indicators: MAP-SAI request from non-home network GT
bulk SAI queries for multiple IMSIs
SAI response containing authentication triplets sent externally
SAI origination outside expected authentication flow
repeated SAI retries after rejection
FGT5020.detection_guidance: Monitor MAP-SAI message rates from external peers. Alert on SAI requests not correlated with active call or location update. Block SAI responses to non-authorized GTs.
FGT5020.mitigation_guidance: Deploy SS7 application firewall blocking unauthorized SAI. Implement authentication vector response filtering. Upgrade to Diameter/5G AKA where possible.

FGT5021.name: GTP-C Tunnel Hijacking
FGT5021.description: Adversary injects or replays GTPv2-C messages on the S11/S5/S8 interfaces to hijack existing PDP/PDN contexts, redirecting user traffic or denying service.
indicators: GTPv2 Create Session Request with mismatched TEID
unexpected Modify Bearer Request from non-serving SGW
TEID collision rate above threshold
GTP-C message from unknown peer IP on S11 interface
sudden subscriber session migration without TAU procedure
FGT5021.detection_guidance: Monitor GTPv2-C for TEID anomalies and unexpected peer IPs. Alert on Create/Modify Session messages outside expected SGW/PGW peer list. Deploy GTP firewall with state tracking.
FGT5021.mitigation_guidance: Enforce GTP peer IP allowlisting. Enable GTP-C message integrity protection where supported. Deploy GTP firewall (3GPP TS 33.210). Segment S11/S5/S8 on dedicated VLAN.

FGT1110.name: Brute Force - 5G AKA / EAP-AKA Authentication
FGT1110.description: Adversary attempts to brute-force 5G-AKA or EAP-AKA authentication challenges by replaying or mutating AUTN/RAND values to derive subscriber keys or cause authentication failures.
indicators: authentication failure rate above 5% per subscriber
repeated RAND values in authentication requests
MAC failure responses from UE spiking
AUTN mismatch errors concentrated on specific IMSIs
authentication request flood from single RAN node
FGT1110.detection_guidance: Track per-IMSI authentication failure rates. Alert on RAND value reuse patterns. Monitor MAC/AUTN failure rates from individual RAN nodes.
FGT1110.mitigation_guidance: Implement per-IMSI authentication rate limiting. Deploy SUCI (Subscription Concealed Identifier) to protect IMSI. Enable AUSF anomaly detection.

FGT1583.name: Acquire Infrastructure - Rogue gNB / Base Station
FGT1583.description: Adversary deploys a rogue 5G base station (gNB) to intercept UE traffic, perform IMSI catching, or inject downgrade attacks to 4G/3G.
indicators: gNB registration from unauthorized IP/certificate
UE reporting unexpected serving cell identity
ARFCN/PCI not in planned network inventory
N2 NGAP Setup Request from unknown gNB IP
unusual PLMN broadcast in cell system information
FGT1583.detection_guidance: Maintain gNB IP and certificate allowlist. Alert on N2 NGAP Setup from unknown sources. Deploy UE-reported cell identity anomaly detection. Monitor RF environment for rogue cell broadcasts.
FGT1583.mitigation_guidance: Enforce gNB certificate-based mutual authentication on N2. Deploy SON (Self-Organising Network) rogue cell detection. Use network-side IMSI catcher detection algorithms.
